column1: # Eclipse's Home against its board, Main.dc.html (design project, "Eclipse theme, Home", 1920 by 1200), one row an element (EmuSen_Qt.md §3.4.8).
# Boxes are the board's pixels; tests/eclipse_home.rs turns each into canvas units as value × canvas::DESIGN_HEIGHT / board_height.
# A box value is a number, "-" (not held: the typeface's, until Eclipse's face is in), or a rule of the board's layout:
#   after:N:g  x is N's right edge + g     in:N:g     x is N's x + g        right:g  the right edge is g short of the window's
#   below:N:g  y is N's bottom + g         foot:N     the bottom is N's     up:N:g   the bottom is g above N's bottom
#   mid:g      the vertical centre is g    mid:N      the vertical centre is N's    above:N:g  the bottom is g above N's top
#   fit:N:g    the right edge is N's right edge + g    inright:N:g  the right edge is g short of N's
# size: a text's board size in board pixels, which the Text draws at exactly, scaled by the board's measure (themes/eclipse/parts/Line.qml;
# R-20261115-24: every text at the board's size, weight, spacing and case).
# colour: a kit token by name, or the board's own as #AARRGGBB. status: built, or nothing (the program has nothing for it,
# so it is not drawn), or ruled (the section tabs, another piece's by R-20261115-7: nothing drawn here).
